name: Clav Quack
description: The envelope on a clav or an electric piano, kept quick and sensitive.

name: Funk Auto-Wah
description: The envelope moves it from the heel: each strum opens it and lets it fall back.

name: Parked Honk
description: Parked three quarters open: the nasal, cutting honk of a lead with the wah left on.

name: Rock Pedal
description: The pedal by itself, half way: automate it, or map an expression pedal to it, and rock it.

name: Slow Sweep
description: The oscillator rocks it slowly over most of its travel, for a chord left ringing.
